study_scope: Anhui under the late Qing, including Huizhou and Wuyuan in the historical province. The 1911 comparison polygon is CHGIS 195004. Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 4. Adopt the Cao province return on its own reporting basis.

Jiangxi with its historical prefectures and Ningdu. Wuyuan then belonged to Anhui. The 1911 comparison polygon is CHGIS 195010. Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 3. Jiujiang is contained in the provincial reporting scope.

Hubei is printed separately from Hunan by Cao. Xu's Huguang figure combines the two and is a comparator. The 1911 comparison polygon is CHGIS 195002. Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 8. Hankou settlement coverage is unquantified and no city or concession is added.
Historical Shaanxi (陕西) as a separate Cao row from Gansu and Shanxi (山西). The 1911 comparison polygon is CHGIS 195003. Ni Table 1.1 p. 18 row 17.
Historical Guizhou, printed separately from Yunnan, Guangxi, Hunan and Sichuan. The 1911 comparison polygon is CHGIS 195018. Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 16.
